summary:
Twitch is the live-streaming site at twitch.tv. The purple glyph in the tab is what viewers look up as a Twitch favicon, and the bytes below were downloaded from that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against twitch.tv. HTML came from https://www.twitch.tv/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 32x32 → https://assets.twitch.tv/assets/favicon-32-5c61aa63605bca4f740d.png; icon 16x16 → https://assets.twitch.tv/assets/favicon-16-24c010b0dab5e56aef81.png.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.twitch.tv/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4286 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.twitch.tv/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #6644aa comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 524 bytes) from https://www.twitch.tv/apple-touch-icon.png.
